title: MaterialCraft nightly deep-background icons
author: @skylartaylor

inputs.purpose: full-bleed 256 master (Windows/Linux, runtime window icon, nightly tar icon)
full-bleed 1024 master; the Mac slots are padded to Apple's 824/1024 grid from it, never upscaled

method.kind: original code-generated derivative of the project-owned icon
method.transform: Fit each pixel as a blend of the tile background and the nearer foreground colour (ink or paper); keep the background weight and replace only the background contribution, so foreground RGBA, alpha and the rounded corners are unchanged. Pack PNG frames into ICO/ICNS at native sizes. No crescent, letter or badge.

validation: Output hashes, PNG CRC/dimensions and exact container members checked; the recolour preserves every exact ink and paper pixel and replaces every exact background pixel. Visual comparison reviewed. Native Explorer/Finder/iconutil/app-package qualification remains unrun.
